Domain: Form Builder Editor Interface & Workspace Tabs
Realistic User Prompt: What tabs are available at the top of the Form Builder, and what is each used for?
Expected Grounded Answer (Pass Criteria): Explains the 3 workspace tabs in Akvo MIS: Edit Form (drag-and-drop questions), Translations (multi-language labels/options), and Preview (interactive testing of validations and skip logic). Clarifies that Akvo MIS does NOT have an in-page JSON tab viewer; JSON is downloaded via the top Export JSON button.
Actual Chatbot Response (Manual Test):
In the 'Form Builder — Edit' page, you will find several tabs at the top. Here’s a brief overview of each tab and its purpose: General: This tab allows you to set the basic settings for your form, including the title, description, and form type.

Fields: Here, you can add, remove, and configure the fields of your form. This includes setting field types (e.g., text, choice, date) and their properties.

Logic: In this tab, you can configure conditional logic for your form fields. This allows you to show or hide questions based on previous answers.

Approvals: This tab is for managing the approval process for submissions. You can define who needs to approve the submissions and under what conditions.

Design: Use this tab to customize the appearance of your form, including color schemes, fonts, and layout options.

Feel free to ask if you need further assistance with any specific tab!
